#   weekday_riders: mean entries per ordinary weekday
#   weekday_riders_median: median entries per ordinary weekday
#   weekday_transfers: mean free transfers counted per weekday
#   weekday_riders_2019: mean entries per ordinary weekday
#   days_with_data: days in 2025 with any ridership recorded

2025 (training target): not exits. Free transfers into the subway from buses or other lines are counted in 'transfers'

2025 (training target): so the other SIR stations show little or no ridership (transit_mode = staten_island_railway). Treat them separately in the model.
